description: Explore the Rijksmuseum's collection, the Dutch national museum's 840,000 objects from Rembrandt and Vermeer to prints, photographs and Delftware. Search by maker, type, material, year or set, get an object's full record and its high-resolution image with its licence (most are public domain), look up makers, and list the museum's sets. No account or API key required.
